camel_example: aliyun servicemesh CreateIstioGatewayDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Hosts 'example.com,demo.com' --Number 443 --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --Protocol HTTPS --PortName 'http-demo' --IstioGatewayName ingressgateway
description_en: Creates a domain name certificate for a gateway
description_zh: 调用CreateIstioGatewayDomains创建网关域名证书
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh create-istio-gateway-domains --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --istio-gateway-name ingressgateway --hosts example.com,demo.com --number 443 --port-name http-demo --protocol HTTPS --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIstioGatewayDomains

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the ASM gateway
parameters.name: istio_gateway_name

parameters.help_en: One or more hosts exposed by the gateway. Separate multiple hosts with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 此网关公开的一个或多个主机，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: hosts

parameters.help_en: The port number provided by the gateway
parameters.name: number

parameters.help_en: The name of the secret that contains the Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate and the certificate authority (CA) certificate
parameters.help_zh: 包含TLS证书、CA证书的密钥名称
parameters.name: credential

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enforce TLS encryption for connections. Valid values:

`true`: Enforces TLS encryption for connections.

`false`: Does not enforce TLS encryption for connections
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制使用TLS保护连接，取值：

`true`：强制使用TLS保护连接。

`false`：不强制使用TLS保护连接
parameters.name: force_https

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of gateway resources to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询网关资源数目上限
parameters.name: limit
